name: THE FIDDLER
note: Doc 07 #11. 'The Nugget. Tuned to the flat piano, therefore flat. Corrects first in Act IV.' He stands by the piano with his fiddle. HIS BARKS ARE ALL PLAYING (doc 07: 'mostly just playing'): none is a spoken line, so his file has none, and what doc 07 writes for R_BORDERS_MOTT, R_DEAD and R_TRUTH -- something faster, the passing tune, the A tuned in F2 -- is music, not yet made (errata 110). Doc 22: he idles in time with the bar grid.
barksNote: Doc 07 §11 writes him three barks and all three are directions -- playing -- not words; none is a bark a balloon can carry (errata 110).

sprite.frameNote: HIS IDLE IS HIS PLAYING: 0 the bow out at the start of the stroke and 1 drawn across to its end, alternating at 0.85 (about 0.6 s a stroke) · 2 mid-stroke, for a busier passage in the second break · 3 TUNE, the fiddle at his chest, a peg turned -- the first break · 4 TALK, fiddle and bow lowered. Doc 22 wants the bowing on the music's bar grid; the score has no bar grid yet, so the rate is fixed (errata 111).
